items.title: Not working on Silksong suddenly.

labels.name: needs-replication
labels.description: Issue needs to be replicated by BepInEx dev

labels.name: error
labels.description: Error message or log that may need investigation

items.body:
### What happened?

Ok so the last two days I've been using BepInEx to use the Silksong Customizer mod.  That is the only mod I have used with it and it worked just fine up till this morning.  I turn off my PC each night and when I turn it on and start up Silksong I notice the skin I'm using isn't there.  Then I also notice I can't open the BepInEx menu with F1.  So I remove the mod and try launching the game again with only BepInEx, still nothing.  So I suspect it's BepInEx not working.

I've tried just about everything I can think of and here's a list of everything I've done.
-Checking if Windows updated in the night (it did not, it's the same version as it was when BepInEx worked)
-Checking if Silksong updated (It also has not, same version as when BepInEx worked)
-Restarting my PC
-Uninstalling BepInEx and reinstalling it
-Uninstalling BepInEx and then uninstalling Silksong and reinstalling both, launching Silksong once before installing BepInEx again.
-Trying the Vortex mod launcher and using BepInEx through there. (Saw a comment on Nexus that said it worked through the launcher)
-Deleting Vortex and trying again manually by using specifically the version for Silksong on thunderstore.
-Reinstalling it several times seeing each time if Launching Silksong through my desktop shortcut or steam directly would be the solution since the log files said it wasn't launched through steam.

Currently, I have the version of BepInEx installed manually through this link: https://thunderstore.io/c/hollow-knight-silksong/p/BepInEx/BepInExPack_Silksong/  but it still will not show any sign that it's working.  When launching directly through steam after reinstalling BepInEx it doesn't create a log and the only folders in BepInEx are the ones it starts with when downloaded (Config, core and plugins).  It only seems to created the log output alongside the cache and patchers folders when launched through my desktop shortcut.  However, it says in the log output "Application was not launched through Steam! Shutting down..." (through the my desktop shortcut still opens it through steam?  It's just not hitting the play button in the steam app.)  The log output attached it the log it creates when it does this.
If I try launching through steam or my desktop after, nothing happens.  The log isn't updated and Silksong remains Vanilla.

### BepInEx Distribution

3rd party distribution
